title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 18-Inch Iron Straight Bar | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Pipeline Collection | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 18-Inch | Allied Brass, Oil Rubbed Bronze
description:
Add reliable towel storage with an 18-Inch wall mount towel bar designed for the Pipeline collection’s pipe-fitting look in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. This straight bar helps keep towels within reach while the wall-mounted installation saves floor space and supports a clean, organized bathroom.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Wall mount installation to help maximize usable bathroom space
- Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and color-coordinated mounting hardware
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Center-to-center: 18 inches
- Bar diameter: 0.75 inch
- Projection: 3.3 inches
- Overall size: 18 in L x 3 in H x 3.3 in W
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
